thread:
Ellen: HarborBridge POC hitting weird TTFT spikes and occasional 429s during ramp. Customer reports bursts at ~450 rps. Can ops/sales triage? :raised_eyebrow:
Diego: can you paste sample req ids + model/route + client conn pattern? single connection per client?
Ellen: route=/v1/generate model=redwood-3b-econ variant=quant-e1 reqs=r_hb_01 r_hb_02 r_hb_03
Ellen: client opens 4 persistent connections per instance (autoscaling fleet). prefill=true, prefill_tokens=24, batch_window_ms=15
Marta: thanks. Logs please. Even a tiny snippet helps.
Ellen: attaching logs:
Ellen: ```
[2026-06-10T11:02:21.001Z] req=r_hb_01 lat_ms=1120 status=200 batch_size=1 kv_hit=false shard=shard-4
[2026-06-10T11:02:21.013Z] req=r_hb_02 lat_ms=52 status=200 batch_size=18 kv_hit=true shard=shard-1
[2026-06-10T11:02:21.450Z] req=r_hb_03 lat_ms=1300 status=429 batch_size=1 kv_hit=false shard=shard-4
```
Diego: pattern: slow + 429s tied to shard-4, small batch_size, kv misses. Likely affinity lost because multiple connections per client -> prefill on one shard and continue on another.
Marta: checking shard health...
Marta: ```
$ redwoodctl shard-inspect shard-4 --last 30m
kv_hit_rate: 21%
active_variants: [quant-e1, quant-d1]
evictions_per_min: 4
cpu_load: 78%
```
Marta: low kv_hit_rate + mixed variants on shard-4 -> warmup thrash.
Ellen: customer gateway also does short keepalive and rotates connections aggressively.
Diego: two-pronged fix: 1) immediate: enable connection-affinity on our load balancer for that customer or ask customer to reduce connection churn 2) medium: route by model-variant so shards don't mix quant-e1 and quant-d1
Marta: quick mitigation: bump batch_window_ms to 40ms and prefill_tokens to 96 for a trial. That should increase batch_size and kv warm probability.
Cluster-bot: scale: pool harborbridge-pool add_shards=1 (rolling) :gear: status=started
Diego: also check kernel-selection traces for slow reqs once we have a trace id. If we see fallback kernels or matmul cold paths that suggests variant mixing.
Ellen: customer also asked about cost delta if we recommend Dedicated for predictable SLA. They want per-token hosted vs small Dedicated pool numbers.
Pricing-bot: ballpark: hosted ~0.0011/token for 3b under this workload. Small Dedicated (2 x A100-equivalent) amortized ~0.0006/token at 70% util. Final depends on commit and utilization.
Marta: after shard add and config tweak, re-run looks better: 9/10 requests < 90ms, a couple still ~420ms but 429s gone. New trace id t_hb_0610_1108 posted.
Diego: got trace, seeing warmup on some requests where prefill landed on different shard than follow-up tokens -> confirming affinity issue. If customer can't change gateway, we should enable server-side per-client session pinning for their tenant.
Ellen: customer prefers server-side pinning. How fast can we enable tenant-affinity?
Marta: ops can flip tenant.affinity=true for a customer in minutes for test. We'll run 30m test and capture metrics.
Diego: closing notes: 1) enable tenant-affinity test 2) bump prefill_tokens and batch_window during test 3) consider Dedicated trial if they want to eliminate noisy neighbor risk 4) flag KMS onboarding if Dedicated chosen.
Ellen: I'll send remediation steps + ask if they want Dedicated trial. Thanks all :rocket:
